findings: Nine controls fail on missing application-owned nosniff headers.
Two controls fail because stable manifest/icon assets are immutable for a year.
The unserved invitation module receives the shell fallback and wrong MIME type.
readings.limit: The invitation HTML control stops at its header assertion; this reading does not independently prove that control reached the inline-script assertions.

findings: The actual /rating document returns the JSON API's 401 instead of the app shell.
Two test setup calls omit the JSON body required by logout and receive 400.
readings.repair: Negotiate Rating HTML/JSON at application composition with Accept and Vary; send the existing empty JSON logout body in the browser setup.

readings.finding: The new test expects a heading named Rating, but the actual screen heading is Your measured record.
readings.repair: Use the existing exact accessible heading for both direct entry and reload; do not alter product copy or replace the journey with a request-only assertion.

unchanged: No performance thresholds, receive deadlines, body limits or security refusals were relaxed.
No retry count was increased and no new journey was skipped.
D3397 remains a separate CSP contract hold, not a green policy claim.
